channel.title: Rehoboam AI News Banner
channel.description: Curated AI news milestones for Jochim's personal website banner.

item.title: US government forces Anthropic to disable Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for foreign nationals
item.description: Anthropic says a US export-control directive forced it to abruptly suspend Fable 5 and Mythos 5 access for foreign nationals worldwide, creating a major precedent for government control over frontier-model access.

item.title: OpenAI to acquire Ona for long-running agents
item.description: OpenAI announced an acquisition aimed at secure cloud execution for long-running agent workflows.

item.title: Anthropic backtracks on opaque frontier-model safeguard rerouting
item.description: Anthropic said it will make frontier-model safeguards more transparent after researchers found requests could be silently routed to a lesser model.

item.title: Xiaomi releases MiMo Code agentic coding harness
item.description: Xiaomi's open-source terminal-native coding assistant claims strong performance on ultra-long 200+ step software tasks.

item.title: EU orders Meta to open WhatsApp to rival AI chatbots
item.description: EU regulators ordered Meta to stop blocking rival AI assistants from the WhatsApp Business API.

item.title: Google introduces DiffusionGemma for faster text generation
item.description: DiffusionGemma is a 26B mixture-of-experts text diffusion model targeting lower latency and up to 4x faster generation on GPUs.

item.title: OpenAI weighs Nvidia-backed 10 GW Ohio data-center lease
item.description: A reported 10 GW campus lease would be a major signal of frontier-AI infrastructure demand and compute scaling.

item.title: Dario Amodei publishes AI-exponential policy agenda
item.description: Anthropic's CEO argued for faster AI policy work, including mandatory testing and stronger security standards.
